Evan: FYI saw a spike in mTLS handshake failures from eu-west -> proxy after the RBAC roll yesterday. Errors look like KMS DENY during cert unwrap.
Priya: @Evan which service and exact error line?
Evan: Service: ingest-proxy-eu. Log snippet: `2026-03-20T23:11:04Z ERROR tls_handshake.go:142: decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = requestor does not have permission to decrypt with key projects/redwood/locations/eu/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/ingest-key`
Mike: That screams removed `cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` binding for the proxy SA. Did the rotator change the key version or the IAM?
Priya: Checked audit — IAM binding for that SA was removed at 23:10 UTC by `deploy-bot` in PR #4523 (rbac: tighten keystore-reader).
Evan: We have short-lived cached key material but it expired ~23:12 and then handshakes started failing.
Jordan: Incident path: 1) KMS IAM change -> 2) decrypt denied -> 3) proxy can't unwrap client cert -> 4) mTLS handshake fail. We should enable KMS audit logging and an alert for permission_denied spikes.
Mike: Agree. Immediate mitigation: re-add the IAM binding for the service account to restore decrypt rights. I'll perform the revert and roll the rotator rules to exclude that SA from the automated tighten. Command: ``gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/eu/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/ingest-key --member=serviceAccount:proxy-eu@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter``
Priya: Long-term we need: - stricter deploy checks (deny IAM removes without preflight key-access smoke tests) - enable KMS audit sink to bigquery for quick queries - add canary for rotator so it doesn't revoke access globally at once
Evan: Can we enable local keystore fallback on the proxy while we revert? There's an env var we can flip to use cached keys for 1h: `REDWOOD_KEYSTORE_FALLBACK=1`
Mike: Doing revert now. I'll also create a scoped rollback PR and tag rotator owner.
sec-bot: Incident created INC-20260320-54; severity=P2; assignee=Mike; playbook=https://confluence.redwood/internal/kms-rbac-playbook
Evan: After I flipped fallback and Mike reapplied IAM, handshakes recovered ~23:16 UTC. Past 5m shows no new denies but I'll keep monitoring.
Jordan: Follow-ups: - add KMS permission_denied alert (threshold 5/min) - add preflight test in deploy pipeline that calls `gcloud kms test-iam-permissions` for affected SAs - update rotator to do canary revokes over 24h with health checks
Priya: Also add a CI job that runs mTLS smoke tests across eu/apac regions on any keystore/rotator IAM change.
Evan: Noted. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Mike: Filing a post-incident action (PIR) with timelines and owner assignments.
Jordan: Marking this thread for the PIR doc.
Priya: +1
Evan: +1
